label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (sql-injection) is TP. User input 'param' from request.getParameter is concatenated directly into SQL string 'q' on line 21 without sanitization or prepared statements. The resolved sink value at line 22 ('pendingSql' attribute) is the SQL string 'q', which contains attacker-controlled data. While execution is not shown in this method, the construction of dynamic SQL with user input is a verified vulnerability.

evidence.note: User input 'param' concatenated into SQL string 'q' and stored in request attribute without sanitization.
